hook: Matrix multiplication's exponent is exactly nine fourths

beats.say: A new OpenAI preprint proves a lower bound for multiplying square matrices: any formal arithmetic circuit needs at least n to the nine fourths, over two, multiplication or division gates.
The matching upper bound was already known, from OpenAI over the complex numbers and from Amanov, van den Berg and Zuiddam over every field.
Together they pin the exponent at exactly 2.25, which settles the long-open question of whether it could reach 2.
